sources.games: 453 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats, support position: under 2.5 last hits a minute), win 46.1%. One rule: Glimmer Cape against three or more magic damage heroes (42 games, 11 without it). Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py snapfire.

rules.name: Glimmer Cape
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Glimmer Cape (2150 gold): after a 0.5 s delay invisibility, +20 movement speed and a 375 magic damage barrier for 5 s on you or an ally, 600 cast range, 15 s cooldown. It is in her build (63% of the won games, ~21 min); against three or more magic damage heroes she buys it in 74% of 42 games (52% otherwise), won 52% against 18% (11 games without it).

reason.en: {enemy} and other magic damage heroes are in their team: {item} is in your build, take it earlier, it gives you or an ally a 375 magic damage barrier for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} та інші герої з магічною шкодою: {item} і так у вашій збірці — візьміть його раніше, він дає вам або союзнику магічний бар'єр на 375 шкоди на 5 секунд

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 97% (1), magic_wand 84% (4), ring_of_basilius 97% (8), arcane_boots 97% (12), aghanims_shard 66% (20), glimmer_cape 63% (21), headdress 24% (21), mekansm 21% (23), staff_of_wizardry 54% (25), blink 36% (25), force_staff 31% (27). Reviewed: dropped Ring of Basilius, Headdress, Mekansm (21%), Staff of Wizardry (parts). STRATZ pos4: Blink Dagger 21 min (44% of 4628 games), earlier than the league games (36%, 25 min); pos5 has no build.
